# czc-v2026.10.24.1 (0.2.17.27)

User channel-status cards now show each monitor's public group rate
(the same `Nx` badge used on 可用渠道), including a user's custom rate
and peak-window rates when they apply.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.23.3

### Channel-status group rates

- V1 user monitor list joins active groups and returns `group_id`,
  `group_platform`, `subscription_type`, `rate_multiplier`, and peak
  fields. Matching is trim + case-insensitive `group_name`, then the
  monitor `name` if `group_name` is empty. Unmatched monitors keep the
  old name-only chip.
- The V1 card renders `GroupBadge` with `always-show-rate` and loads
  `/groups/rates` so a user's custom multiplier is shown next to the
  group default.
- V2 dimensions and matrix rows carry the same rate fields. Matrix
  labels and group filters append `×N` (and peak when it differs).
- Production remains on V1 probe. This release does not switch the
  monitor mode and does not create missing probe monitors.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.27`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in. No database migration and no configuration change.

Existing monitors whose `group_name` does not match an active group
will not show a rate until that name is aligned. After this deploy:

- `GROK-4.5` (`group_name=grok`) does not match `grok-heavy`.
- `kiro反代claude` is disabled and has an empty `group_name`.
- `devin2claude` is enabled and has an empty `group_name`; it will
  match by monitor name.
- There is still no V1 probe for DeepSeek, Devin-swe2, or
  factory2claude. Those groups will not appear on 渠道状态 until
  monitors are created with keys bound to those groups.

## Compatibility

- Billing, probe routing, and V1/V2 monitor mode are unchanged.
- Rate join failure is logged and the list still renders without
  multipliers.
- User-specific rates come from the existing `/groups/rates` endpoint.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.23.3`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.24.1-<UTC timestamp>` created
during this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`. Rolling back removes
rate badges from 渠道状态; probe monitors and billing are unchanged.
